title: YouTube Video Summarizer
description:
Tutorials, talks and lectures on YouTube are often 30 minutes or longer, and it is hard to tell in advance which parts are relevant. A tool should produce a short summary, the key points and chapter timestamps, so viewers can decide what to watch and jump to the right place.

Constraints: transcripts of long videos exceed what fits comfortably into one model request, so they must be processed in parts; some videos have no captions, so speech-to-text is needed as a fallback; timestamps must come from the transcript, not be invented; access to YouTube content must respect its terms of service.
goals:
• Accept all common YouTube URL forms (watch, youtu.be, shorts, embed, live)
  • Use existing captions when available and transcribe the audio only as a fallback
  • Handle transcripts of any length by chunking
  • Return a summary, 5 to 7 key points and chapters whose timestamps all appear in the transcript
  • Allow running fully locally with an open model for private or internal videos
